packages.@tanstack/react-query: Server-state cache for the web app; the tRPC client is built on it.
packages.@trpc/server: tRPC router and procedures on the API. The web app uses it for types only.
packages.@trpc/tanstack-react-query: tRPC integration that exposes procedures as TanStack Query options.
packages.@types/node: Node.js type definitions for the API.
packages.@vitejs/plugin-react: React support (JSX transform, fast refresh) for Vite.
packages.eslint: Linter, run with strict type-checked typescript-eslint rules.
packages.eslint-config-prettier: Turns off ESLint rules that conflict with Prettier.
packages.eslint-plugin-react-hooks: Enforces the rules of hooks in the web app.
packages.react: UI library for the web app.
packages.tsx: Runs the TypeScript API directly, with watch mode for development.
packages.typescript: Compiler used for type checking only (noEmit). Pinned below 6.1 because typescript-eslint does not yet support 7.0.
packages.typescript-eslint: TypeScript parser and rules for ESLint.
packages.vite: Dev server and bundler for the web app.
packages.vitest: Test runner for the API and the packages.
packages.zod: Runtime schemas; the TypeScript types are inferred from them.

env.PORT: Port the API listens on. Vite proxies /trpc to it.
env.LOG_LEVEL: Fastify log level: fatal, error, warn, info, debug, trace or silent.
env.DATABASE_URL: Database connection string: SQLite locally, Postgres in production. Arrives with the persistence milestone.
